# Calibration decoder fixtures

- `DisplayP3-v4.icc`: saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles, CC0/public domain.
  https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles/blob/master/profiles/DisplayP3-v4.icc
  Used to encode real PNG/JPEG/TIFF/HEIC containers at test time. No Apple profile
  or owner's photograph is included.
- `gainmap.heic`: Google's synthetic 16×16 HEVC primary + gain map fixture,
  Apache-2.0 OR MIT. Its exact upstream provenance and fixture-specific license
  are in `GAINMAP_FIXTURE_README.md` (upstream filename gainmap_hevc_16x16.heic).
  https://github.com/google/libultrahdr/blob/5f117294cb701170b9198ed8eae16270aa84896c/tests/data/gainmap_hevc_16x16.heic
- `ultrahdr.jpg`: generated for Ventanal from synthetic 32×32 half-float RGBA
  pixels; no third-party photo. Left half (2,.5,.25,1), right half (4,2,1,1).
  Generated using Google libultrahdr revision
  `5f117294cb701170b9198ed8eae16270aa84896c`, built with UHDR_WRITE_XMP=ON
  and UHDR_WRITE_ISO=ON (JPEG, SDR primary plus gain map). Encoder command:
  `ultrahdr_app -m 0 -p hdr.raw -w 32 -h 32 -a 4 -t 0 -C 0 -z ultrahdr.jpg`.
  Generated fixture: CC0/public domain. Library: Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
- Real uncompressed Bayer DNGs are generated by `test_calraw.dng` using tifffile,
  including CFA pattern, DNG version, camera matrix and white level. Test camera
  pixels are synthetic, no third-party image or camera profile is used.

All committed fixtures are small and tests run offline. The decoder does not
apply auxiliary gain maps. Processed ICC transforms are relative-colorimetric
sRGB: out-of-sRGB gamut values clip at this transform boundary; RAW camera-matrix
conversion is limited by LibRaw's 16-bit output. Neither path reconstructs
saturated sensor channels or reverses a phone's tone mapping.
